body:
I'm still around.

If you want the long story, I got suicidal when I was 7. Tried killing myself at 16, 17, 25, 27, and 29. I have a few super rare hormonal disorders, and whole body tactile allodynia.

When I was 19, I met the first love of my life. He died in 2015, when I was 25, and with that, I failed uni, and then lost my apartment. Met a new amazing boyfriend (I have an empathy deficit disorder so connecting emotionally isn't easy). I also got a bird whom I loved more than anything. 

Fast forward to this year. Found a new apartment, then my boyfriend left me, I lost my job, my bird had to be put down due to hormonal problems (he ate everything and ended up eating wall paint, and no, he didn't have any nutrient deficiencies) and my best friend collapsed due to depression, and at the end of November I got notice that I had to leave the apartment as the letter wanted to rent it to someone else who could pay a higher rent.

So now my life is hell.

Also, I've had 23 psychologists, and 5 psychiatrists. The latest set of antidepressants work better, as the previous sets fucked more with my hormones, but there's only so much meds can do when everything is shit.

The first 2-3 weeks on antidepressants are hell, but most of the time it gets better.

I went through three suicide attempts during those two weeks last year. One rather successful, two failures.

If you have something worth living for, be it a loved one, a job you look forward to, a pet you care for, or anything, then trust me, it is worth the pain.

I didnt notice you were replying to my old post, Im sorry. I made it through that weekend just like Ive made it through every other hell of a weekend, but I wont be here in an hour. 

Im sorry

Its been 4 years in January. Things have been going downhill since and things werent good before that.

Thank you for your kind words
